CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations) is identified and presented as a current record, with an explicit origin/status field.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit identifications of content (red/blue) with coordinate sets are present.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields explicitly distinguish the identified content from its source/status.

O.rationale: Entries label contents as 'current' or 'candidate' records, indicating how they are presented/accessed.
